logp.method_description: Aqueous solution of Ir(III) complexes (5 mL, 100 μM) was mixed thoroughly with n-octanol (5S9mL) in a 15 mL centrifuge tube. The tube was wrapped in aluminium foil, shaken for 24 h in athermostatic shaker incubator and allowed to settle until the two phases were completely separated.The oil/water distribution coefficients (log PO/W) were calculated using the relative concentrationsof Ir(III) complex in the two phases.6, 10 For absorbance below 0.002, it is used as < 0.002 for logPO/W calculation. The error of log PO/W is ± 0.04
